name: corpus-locate-20
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import glob,hashlib,json,os
base="/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/lanes/pi-mathdb-full-corpus-inventory-r301/corpus"
ids=[349943,346153,347791,349042,350668,338937,340221,381331,332023,326946,324243,380396,380398,378950,380771,334069,361816,368351,371095,360178]
want=set(ids)
files=sorted(glob.glob(base+"/mathdb-normalized-chunk-*.jsonl"))
print("NCHUNKS",len(files))
found={}
for f in files:
    with open(f,"rb") as fh:
        raw=fh.read()
    fh_sha=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    lines=raw.split(b"\n")
    # last element after trailing newline is empty
    for i,line in enumerate(lines,1):
        if not line.strip(): continue
        try: obj=json.loads(line.decode("utf-8"))
        except Exception: continue
        mid=obj.get("mathdb_id")
        if mid in want and mid not in found:
            st=obj.get("statement")
            if isinstance(st,str): stb=st.encode("utf-8")
            else: stb=json.dumps(st,ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
            found[mid]={"chunk":os.path.basename(f),"chunk_sha":fh_sha,"line":i,
                        "raw_sha":hashlib.sha256(line).hexdigest(),
                        "newline":raw.endswith(b"\n"),
                        "stmt_sha":hashlib.sha256(stb).hexdigest(),
                        "stmt_len":len(st), "stmt":st,
                        "title":obj.get("title"), "keys":sorted(obj.keys())}
print("FOUND",len(found))
json.dump(found,open("literal-scan-raw.json","w",encoding="utf-8"),ensure_ascii=False)
for mid in ids:
    v=found.get(mid)
    if not v:
        print("MISSING",mid); continue
    print("ID",mid,"chunk",v["chunk"],"line",v["line"],"rawsha",v["raw_sha"][:16],"stmtlen",v["stmt_len"])
print("KEYS_SAMPLE",found[ids[0]]["keys"] if ids[0] in found else None)
